text: “ଯେତେ ବଡ଼ ମୁଣ୍ଡ, ସେତେ ବଡ଼ …” — ଏହି ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଢଗଟି କେଉଁ ଶବ୍ଦରେ ଶେଷ ହୁଏ?
gloss: "The bigger the head, the bigger the …" — which word ends this Odia saying? — Headache: «ଯେତେ ବଡ଼ ମୁଣ୍ଡ, ସେତେ ବଡ଼ ମୁଣ୍ଡବିନ୍ଧା» (more standing, more worries).

text: ଶ୍ରୀମନ୍ଦିରର ରତ୍ନସିଂହାସନରେ ଜଗନ୍ନାଥ ଓ ବଳଭଦ୍ରଙ୍କ ମଝିରେ କେଉଁ ଦେବୀ ବିରାଜମାନ?
gloss: On the jewelled throne of the Puri temple, which goddess sits between Jagannath and Balabhadra? — Subhadra, their sister. Lakshmi (his consort) and Bimala have their own shrines in the temple.

text: ଗୋଟିଏ ଲମ୍ବା ଦଉଡ଼ିକୁ ନ ମୋଡ଼ି ସିଧାସଳଖ ତିନି ଜାଗାରେ କାଟିଲେ କେତେ ଖଣ୍ଡ ହେବ?
gloss: A long rope, not folded, is cut in three places. How many pieces? — Four: each cut adds one piece to the original one. "Three" is the autopilot trap.

text: ଜହ୍ନର ନିଜର କୌଣସି ଆଲୁଅ ନାହିଁ। ରାତିରେ ତାକୁ ଚମକାଉଥିବା ଆଲୁଅ ଆସଲରେ କାହାର?
gloss: The Moon has no light of its own. Whose light makes it shine at night? — The Sun's: moonlight is reflected sunlight.

text: ଖରାଦିନେ ରନ୍ଧା ଭାତରେ ପାଣି ଢାଳି, ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ଆଳୁଭଜା, ବଡ଼ିଚୁରା କି ପୋଡ଼ା ବାଇଗଣ ଦେଇ ଖିଆଯାଉଥିବା ଖାଦ୍ୟଟି କ'ଣ?
gloss: In summer, cooked rice soaked in water, eaten with fried potato, badi chura or roast brinjal — what is it? — Pakhala, Odisha's signature summer meal.

text: କ୍ରିକେଟରେ ଜଣେ ବ୍ୟାଟର ଗୋଟିଏ ଓଭରର ପ୍ରତିଟି ବଲରେ ଛକା ମାରିଲେ, କୌଣସି ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ବଲ ନ ଥିଲେ, ସେହି ଓଭରରୁ ତାଙ୍କର କେତେ ରନ ହେବ?
gloss: A batter hits a six off every ball of an over, with no extras. How many runs? — 36: six balls × six runs. Needs both facts (6 balls an over, 6 for a six).

text: ମା'ଙ୍କ ବାପାଙ୍କୁ ଆମେ ଅଜା ଡାକୁ। ଅଜାଙ୍କ ପୁଅ ଆମ ପାଇଁ କିଏ?
gloss: We call mother's father 'aja'. Who is aja's son to us? — Mamu, mother's brother. Dada is father's elder brother, Mausa and Piusa are uncles by marriage.

text: କାର୍ଟୁନ “ଟମ ଆଣ୍ଡ ଜେରି”ରେ ଟମ ଗୋଟିଏ ବିଲେଇ। ତାକୁ ସବୁବେଳେ ନାକେଦମ କରୁଥିବା ଜେରି କେଉଁ ପ୍ରାଣୀ?
gloss: In 'Tom and Jerry' Tom is a cat. What animal is Jerry, who always runs rings round him? — A mouse. Squirrel is the near miss.

text: ନୂଆ ଦଶ ଟଙ୍କିଆ ନୋଟର ପଛପଟେ ଓଡ଼ିଶାର ଗୋଟିଏ ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ ମନ୍ଦିରର ଛବି ଛପା ହୋଇଛି। କେଉଁ ମନ୍ଦିର?
gloss: The back of the new ten-rupee note shows a famous Odisha temple. Which? — The Sun Temple at Konark (2018 Mahatma Gandhi New Series ₹10 note).

text: ଧଳା ପଟ ଉପରେ ମଝିରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଲାଲ ଗୋଲ — ଏହା କେଉଁ ଦେଶର ଜାତୀୟ ପତାକା?
gloss: A red disc in the middle of a white field — whose national flag? — Japan. Bangladesh is the trap: its red disc is on green.

text: “କଟକ” ନାମଟିକୁ ଓଲଟା ପଟୁ ପଢ଼ିଲେ ବି “କଟକ” ହିଁ ହୁଏ। ତଳ ଶବ୍ଦଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟିରେ ଏହି ଗୁଣ ଅଛି?
gloss: 'Kataka' (Cuttack) reads the same backwards. Which of these words does too? — Nayana (eye): ନ-ୟ-ନ. The others reverse to non-words (ରଗନ, ରଅନ, ମରନ).

text: ବଜାରରୁ ଦେଢ଼ ଶହ ଟଙ୍କାର ମାଛ ଆଉ ଅଢ଼େଇ ଶହ ଟଙ୍କାର ପରିବା କିଣିଲେ ମୋଟ କେତେ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ହେଲା?
gloss: Fish for 'dedh shaha' and vegetables for 'adhei shaha' rupees: total? — Four hundred: dedh = 1½ (150), adhei = 2½ (250). The native fraction words do the work.

text: ମିଥୁନ ସଂକ୍ରାନ୍ତି ବେଳେ ତିନି ଦିନ ଝିଅମାନେ ଦୋଳି ଖେଳନ୍ତି, ପୋଡ଼ପିଠା ଖାଆନ୍ତି, ଆଉ ମାଟି ଖୋଳା ବନ୍ଦ ରହେ। ଏହା କେଉଁ ପର୍ବ?
gloss: Around Mithuna Sankranti, for three days girls swing, eat poda pitha and the earth is not dug. Which festival? — Raja, when Mother Earth is believed to rest before the farming season.

text: ପହିଲି ଏପ୍ରିଲକୁ ଓଡ଼ିଆମାନେ ଉତ୍କଳ ଦିବସ ଭାବେ ପାଳନ୍ତି, କାରଣ ସେହି ଦିନ ଓଡ଼ିଶା ଭାଷା ଆଧାରରେ ଏକ ଅଲଗା ପ୍ରଦେଶ ହୋଇଥିଲା। କେଉଁ ବର୍ଷ?
gloss: Odias keep 1 April as Utkal Divas, the day Odisha became a separate province on the basis of language. Which year? — 1936. 1912 is when Bihar and Orissa left Bengal; 1956 the States Reorganisation.

text: ଜମିର ମାପରୁ ନାମ ପାଇଥିବା ଉପନ୍ୟାସ “ଛ ମାଣ ଆଠ ଗୁଣ୍ଠ” କିଏ ଲେଖିଥିଲେ?
gloss: Who wrote the novel named after a land measure, 'Chha Mana Atha Guntha' (Six Acres and a Third)? — Fakir Mohan Senapati. The others are poets.

text: ଲୁହାରେ କଳଙ୍କି ଲାଗିବାକୁ ପାଣି ସହିତ ବାୟୁରୁ ଆଉ କେଉଁ ଗ୍ୟାସ ଦରକାର?
gloss: Besides water, which gas from the air does iron need to rust? — Oxygen: rust is iron oxide. Nitrogen is the most plentiful gas in air, the trap.

text: ଏଭରେଷ୍ଟ ଶିଖରର ଚୂଡ଼ା ଦେଇ କେଉଁ ଦୁଇ ଦେଶର ସୀମା ଯାଇଛି?
gloss: The border of which two countries runs over the summit of Everest? — Nepal and China (Tibet).

text: ଦୌଡ଼ ପ୍ରତିଯୋଗିତାରେ ଆପଣ ଦୁଇ ନମ୍ବରରେ ଦୌଡ଼ୁଥିବା ଜଣକୁ ପଛରେ ପକାଇଦେଲେ। ଏବେ ଆପଣ କେଉଁ ସ୍ଥାନରେ?
gloss: In a race you overtake the runner in second place. Where are you now? — Second: you took their place, the leader is still ahead. "First" is the trap.

text: ପ୍ରତିବର୍ଷ ଗହିରମଥା ଓ ଋଷିକୁଲ୍ୟା ମୁହାଣ ବେଳାଭୂମିକୁ ହଜାର ହଜାର “ଅଲିଭ ରିଡଲେ” ଏକାଠି ଅଣ୍ଡା ଦେବାକୁ ଆସନ୍ତି। ଏମାନେ କେଉଁ ପ୍ରାଣୀ?
gloss: Every year thousands of 'Olive Ridleys' come together to lay eggs on the beaches of Gahirmatha and the Rushikulya mouth. What are they? — Sea turtles. Saltwater crocodiles live next door in Bhitarkanika, the trap.

text: ଶ୍ରୀଜଗନ୍ନାଥଙ୍କ ନବକଳେବର ସେହି ବର୍ଷରେ ହିଁ ହୁଏ, ଯେଉଁ ବର୍ଷ ପଞ୍ଜିକାରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ମାସ ଦୁଇ ଥର ଆସେ। କେଉଁ ମାସ?
gloss: Jagannath's Nabakalebara (renewal of the wooden idols) happens only in a year when one month comes twice. Which? — Ashadha (an adhika Ashadha year), as in 1996 and 2015. Jyeshtha (Snana Purnima) is the trap.

text: ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଭାଷାରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ମହାଭାରତ କାହାର ରଚନା?
gloss: Who wrote the first complete Mahabharata in Odia? — Sarala Das (15th century). The others are the later Panchasakha poets: Jagannath Das wrote the Odia Bhagabata, Balaram Das the Jagamohana Ramayana.

text: ଦେବନାଗରୀ ଅକ୍ଷର ଉପରେ ସିଧା ଗାର, ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଅକ୍ଷର ଉପରେ ଗୋଲ ଛତା। କୁହାଯାଏ, ଲୁହା ଲେଖନୀରେ ଲମ୍ବା ସିଧା ଗାର ଟାଣିଲେ ଲେଖିବା ଜିନିଷଟି ଚିରିଯାଉଥିଲା। ସେ ଜିନିଷ କ'ଣ?
gloss: Devanagari has a straight top line, Odia letters a round 'umbrella'. A long straight line drawn with an iron stylus would split the writing material. What was it? — Palm leaf, which splits along its grain. Copper and stone don't tear; birch bark was written with ink.

text: ଉଚ୍ଚ ପାହାଡ଼ ଉପରେ ଖୋଲା ହାଣ୍ଡିରେ ପାଣି ଟଗବଗ ହୋଇ ଫୁଟୁଛି। ସେହି ଫୁଟନ୍ତା ପାଣିର ତାପମାତ୍ରା କେତେ?
gloss: On a high mountain, water is boiling hard in an open pot. How hot is it? — Below 100 °C: air pressure is lower up there, so water boils sooner, which is why food cooks slowly on mountains.

text: ବିଜୁଳି ଚମକିବାର ପ୍ରାୟ ତିନି ସେକେଣ୍ଡ ପରେ ଘଡ଼ଘଡ଼ି ଶୁଭିଲା। ବିଜୁଳିଟି ଆପଣଙ୍କଠାରୁ ପ୍ରାୟ କେତେ ଦୂରରେ ହୋଇଥିଲା?
gloss: Thunder is heard about three seconds after the lightning flash. How far away was it? — About 1 km: light arrives almost at once, sound travels about 340 m a second.

text: ଓଡ଼ିଶାର ରାଜ୍ୟ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ “ବନ୍ଦେ ଉତ୍କଳ ଜନନୀ”ର ରଚୟିତା କିଏ?
gloss: Who wrote Odisha's state song 'Bande Utkala Janani'? — Kantakabi Laxmikanta Mohapatra. The others are major Odia poets of the same era.

text: ଆପୋଲୋ-୧୧ ଅଭିଯାନରେ ନିଲ ଆର୍ମଷ୍ଟ୍ରଙ୍ଗଙ୍କ ପରେ ଜହ୍ନ ମାଟିରେ ପାଦ ଥାପିଥିବା ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ମଣିଷ କିଏ?
gloss: On Apollo 11, who was the second man to step on the Moon after Neil Armstrong? — Buzz Aldrin. Michael Collins flew the same mission but stayed in orbit.

text: ୧ ରୁ ୧୦୦ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସବୁ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ଲେଖିଲେ ‘୯’ ଅଙ୍କଟି ମୋଟ କେତେ ଥର ଲେଖିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ?
gloss: Writing every number from 1 to 100, how many times do you write the digit 9? — 20: ten times in the units (9, 19 … 99) and ten in the tens (90–99); 99 counts twice.

text: ରୋଷେଇ ଘରର କେଉଁ ମସଲା ଆସଲରେ ନ ଫୁଟିଥିବା ଫୁଲକଢ଼ି, ଯାହାକୁ ଶୁଖାଇ ରଖାଯାଏ?
gloss: Which kitchen spice is really an unopened flower bud, dried? — Clove. Pepper is a berry, cardamom a seed pod, cinnamon a bark.

text: ଶୀତ ଦିନେ ଲଣ୍ଡନରେ ଗ୍ରୀନୱିଚ ସମୟ ଚାଲେ। ଭୁବନେଶ୍ୱରରେ ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟା ସାଢ଼େ ଛଅଟା ହେଲେ ଲଣ୍ଡନରେ ସେତେବେଳେ କେତେଟା?
gloss: In winter London keeps Greenwich time. When it is 6:30 pm in Bhubaneswar, what time is it in London? — 1 pm: Indian time is GMT + 5:30. Midnight is the trap for adding instead of subtracting.

text: ୧୪୯୮ରେ ଆଫ୍ରିକା ବୁଲି ସମୁଦ୍ର ବାଟେ ଭାରତ ପହଞ୍ଚିଥିବା ଭାସ୍କୋ ଦା ଗାମା କେଉଁ ବନ୍ଦର ପାଖରେ ପ୍ରଥମେ ଓହ୍ଲାଇଥିଲେ?
gloss: Sailing round Africa in 1498, near which port did Vasco da Gama first land in India? — Calicut (Kozhikode). Goa became Portuguese only in 1510; Pondicherry was French.

text: ପଟ୍ଟଚିତ୍ର ଗାଁ ଭାବେ ଜଣାଶୁଣା ପୁରୀ ଜିଲ୍ଲାର ରଘୁରାଜପୁରରେ କେଉଁ ଓଡ଼ିଶୀ ଗୁରୁଙ୍କ ଜନ୍ମ ହୋଇଥିଲା?
gloss: Which Odissi guru was born in Raghurajpur, the pattachitra painters' village near Puri? — Kelucharan Mohapatra, who began as a gotipua dancer. The others are the other great Odissi gurus of his generation.

text: କାଳ୍ପନିକ ଗାଁ ମାକୋଣ୍ଡୋକୁ ନେଇ “ଶହେ ବର୍ଷର ନିଃସଙ୍ଗତା” ଲେଖିଥିବା ଗାବ୍ରିଏଲ ଗାର୍ସିଆ ମାର୍କେଜ କେଉଁ ଦେଶର ଲେଖକ?
gloss: Gabriel García Márquez, who wrote 'One Hundred Years of Solitude' about the imaginary village of Macondo, was a writer from which country? — Colombia. He lived for decades in Mexico, the trap.

text: ଜଣେ ରୋଗୀଙ୍କ ରକ୍ତ ଗ୍ରୁପ A ପଜିଟିଭ। ତଳ ଗ୍ରୁପଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟିର ରକ୍ତ ତାଙ୍କୁ ନିରାପଦରେ ଦିଆଯାଇପାରିବ?
gloss: A patient is A positive. Which of these blood groups can safely be given to them? — O negative, the universal donor. B and AB carry the B antigen the patient's body would attack.

text: ବିଷୁବ ରେଖା ତଳ ମହାଦେଶଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ଦେଇ ଯାଇନାହିଁ?
gloss: Which of these continents does the Equator not cross? — Europe. It crosses Africa, South America, and Asia through Indonesia. Asia is the trap for players who picture India.

text: ଘରକଥାର ତିନିଟି ଶବ୍ଦ — ଚାବି, ଆଲମାରି, ବାଲ୍ଟି — ମୂଳତଃ ଗୋଟିଏ ୟୁରୋପୀୟ ଭାଷାର। କେଉଁ ଭାଷା?
gloss: Three household words — chabi (key), almari (cupboard), balti (bucket) — come from one European language. Which? — Portuguese: chave, armário, balde.

text: ପ୍ଲାଷ୍ଟିକ ଖେଳନା ଇଟା “ଲେଗୋ”ର ନାମ ତା' ଦେଶର ଭାଷାରେ “ଭଲ କରି ଖେଳ” ବୁଝାଉଥିବା ଦୁଇ ଶବ୍ଦରୁ ଗଢ଼ା। ଲେଗୋ କମ୍ପାନୀ କେଉଁ ଦେଶର?
gloss: The name of the LEGO toy brick comes from two words meaning 'play well' in its home language. Which country is the LEGO company from? — Denmark (Danish 'leg godt'; founded in Billund).

text: “ଗାନ୍ଧୀ” ଚଳଚ୍ଚିତ୍ରର ପୋଷାକ ପରିକଳ୍ପନା ପାଇଁ ଅସ୍କାର ପାଇ କିଏ ପ୍ରଥମ ଭାରତୀୟ ଅସ୍କାର ବିଜେତା ହୋଇଥିଲେ?
gloss: Who became the first Indian Oscar winner, for the costume design of 'Gandhi'? — Bhanu Athaiya (1983). Satyajit Ray's honorary Oscar came in 1992; Pookutty and Rahman won in 2009.

text: ପଣା ସଂକ୍ରାନ୍ତିରୁ ଓଡ଼ିଆ ନୂଆ ବର୍ଷ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୁଏ। ସେହି ଦିନ ସୂର୍ଯ୍ୟ କେଉଁ ରାଶିରେ ପ୍ରବେଶ କରନ୍ତି?
gloss: The Odia new year begins on Pana Sankranti. Which zodiac sign does the Sun enter that day? — Mesha (Aries), the first sign: the new year starts with the first sign. Makar Sankranti is the trap.

text: ପୁରୁଣା ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଗଣନାରେ କୋଡ଼ିଏ ଗଣ୍ଡାରେ ଏକ ପଣ ହୁଏ। ତେବେ ଏକ ପଣରେ କେତୋଟି ଜିନିଷ?
gloss: In old Odia counting, twenty gandas make one pana. How many items in a pana? — 80: a ganda is four (the fact), so 20 × 4 = 80.

text: ଉଦୟଗିରିର ହାତୀଗୁମ୍ଫା ଶିଳାଲେଖରେ ଯାହାଙ୍କ କୀର୍ତ୍ତି ଖୋଦିତ, ସେହି କଳିଙ୍ଗ ସମ୍ରାଟ ଖାରବେଳ କେଉଁ ରାଜବଂଶର?
gloss: Kharavela, the Kalinga emperor whose deeds are carved in the Hathigumpha inscription at Udayagiri, belonged to which dynasty? — The Mahameghavahana (Chedi) dynasty. The others ruled Odisha centuries later.

text: ଜଣେ କନ୍ନଡ଼ କବିଙ୍କ ସହ ପୁରସ୍କାର ବାଣ୍ଟି ପ୍ରଥମ ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଜ୍ଞାନପୀଠ ବିଜେତା ହୋଇଥିଲେ କିଏ?
gloss: Sharing it with a Kannada poet, who became the first Odia winner of the Jnanpith? — Gopinath Mohanty (1973, with D. R. Bendre). Routray (1986) and Sitakant Mahapatra (1993) won later; Kalindi Charan Panigrahi never did.

text: ଗୋଟିଏ ଦୁଇସୂତା ଡିଏନଏ ଅଣୁରେ ୩୦% କ୍ଷାରକ ଆଡେନିନ। ସେଥିରେ ଗୁଆନିନ କେତେ ପ୍ରତିଶତ?
gloss: In a double-stranded DNA molecule 30% of the bases are adenine. What percentage is guanine? — 20%: adenine pairs with thymine (30%), leaving 40% split equally between guanine and cytosine.

text: ପୂର୍ବଘାଟ ପର୍ବତମାଳାର ଯେଉଁ ଶିଖର ଓଡ଼ିଶାର ସର୍ବୋଚ୍ଚ, ସେଟି କେଉଁ?
gloss: Which Eastern Ghats peak is the highest in Odisha? — Deomali (about 1,672 m, Koraput). Mahendragiri, the better-known peak, is the trap.

text: ଏହି ପକ୍ଷୀର ନାକପୁଡ଼ା ଲମ୍ବା ଥଣ୍ଟର ଏକଦମ ଆଗ ମୁଣ୍ଡରେ, ତେଣୁ ସେ ମାଟି ଭିତରେ ପୋକ ଶୁଙ୍ଘି ଶୁଙ୍ଘି ଖୋଜେ। କେଉଁ ପକ୍ଷୀ?
gloss: This bird's nostrils are at the very tip of its long beak, so it sniffs out worms in the soil. Which bird? — The kiwi, the only bird with nostrils at the tip. The others are its flightless relatives.

text: ରୋଜେଟା ପଥରରେ ଗୋଟିଏ ରାଜାଦେଶ ତିନି ଲିପିରେ ଖୋଦିତ। ସେତେବେଳେ ମିଶରରେ ଟଲେମି ବଂଶର ଶାସନ ଥିଲା, ଆଉ ପଣ୍ଡିତମାନେ ଜାଣିଥିବା ଗୋଟିଏ ଭାଷା ସାହାଯ୍ୟରେ ହାଇରୋଗ୍ଲିଫ ପଢ଼ାଗଲା। ସେ ଭାଷା କେଉଁଟି?
gloss: The Rosetta Stone carries one decree in three scripts. Egypt was then ruled by the Ptolemies, and a language scholars could read unlocked the hieroglyphs. Which? — Ancient Greek: the Ptolemies were a Greek dynasty (the other scripts are hieroglyphic and Demotic).

text: ୧୯୭୧ରେ କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟର ନେଟୱର୍କରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଇ-ମେଲ ପଠାଇ ଠିକଣାରେ ‘@’ ଚିହ୍ନ ବ୍ୟବହାର ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିଥିଲେ କେଉଁ ଇଞ୍ଜିନିୟର?
gloss: Which engineer sent the first email across a computer network in 1971 and started using '@' in addresses? — Ray Tomlinson (ARPANET). Berners-Lee made the Web, Cerf co-designed TCP/IP.

text: ଧ୍ୟାନଚାନ୍ଦଙ୍କ ସମେତ ଭାରତୀୟ ହକି ଦଳ ପ୍ରଥମ ଅଲିମ୍ପିକ ସୁନା ପଦକ କେଉଁ ସହରରେ ଜିତିଥିଲା?
gloss: In which city did India's hockey team, with Dhyan Chand, win its first Olympic gold? — Amsterdam, 1928. Los Angeles (1932) and Berlin (1936) were the next two golds; Paris 1924 was before.

text: ୨୦୧୪ରେ ଓଡ଼ିଆ ଭାରତର ଶାସ୍ତ୍ରୀୟ ଭାଷା ମାନ୍ୟତା ପାଇଲା। ତଳ ଭାଷାଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ଏହି ମାନ୍ୟତା ଓଡ଼ିଆ ପରେ ପାଇଥିଲା?
gloss: Odia became a classical language of India in 2014. Which of these got that status after Odia? — Bengali (October 2024). Tamil (2004), Sanskrit (2005) and Malayalam (2013) came before.

text: ମୋଜାର୍ଟ କେଉଁ ସହରରେ ଜନ୍ମ ନେଇଥିଲେ? ସେହି ସହରର ବିମାନବନ୍ଦର ଆଜି ତାଙ୍କ ନାମରେ।
gloss: In which city was Mozart born? Its airport bears his name today. — Salzburg. He did his greatest work in Vienna, the trap.
